svg.title: Writing ટ
svg.desc: 1 frames; frame N shows movements 1 to N of ટ (gujarati), the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansGujarati-Static.ttf. Stroke order after t30apps.com, ‘Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice’, version 1.0, ટ animation, first SVG path <https://www.t30apps.com/gujarati-alphabet-writing/>. Source note on variation: The teaching app animates ટ as one continuous pen-down run in its first SVG path; its remaining path slots are empty. The run begins at the upper left, sweeps right across the rounded upper turn, bends diagonally down-left through the middle, then circles clockwise around the broad lower bowl and finishes on its right side without lifting. The app explicitly says that depicted forms and stroke orders can differ by source and should be treated as one variant, not a universal standard. The bundled Noto Sans Gujarati glyph preserves the upper turn, diagonal middle transition, and broad lower bowl, but its printed turns are broader and more angular than the animated school-hand form. This learner path preserves the source's upper-turn-to-middle-to-lower-bowl order and zero-lift evidence while fitting the continuous run to the font's ink. Individual handwriting may narrow, round, simplify, retrace, or slant the turns, transition, bowl, and terminals differently.
svg.text: How it is written — one unbroken stroke · 1 movement
